primitives.name: Geometric Silicate Lattice Formation
primitives.verbatim_quote: `01-crystallization`: *The Inert Matrix* — Geometric silicate lattices suspended in sub-zero atmospheric vapor.
primitives.assumptions: Silicate lattice formation occurs at sub-zero temperatures with constant pressure and vapor saturation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T < T_collapse where T_collapse is critical nucleation threshold.

layer2.mapping: Lattice geometry maps to discrete group actions on crystallographic space groups via symmetry-breaking transformations.
layer2.telemetry: Real-time lattice strain tensor and defect density measurements.

primitives.name: Dynamic Polymer Refractive Shear
primitives.verbatim_quote: `02-fluid-shear`: *The Viscous Transition* — Gelatinous refractive polymers yielding to dynamic fluid drag forces.
primitives.assumptions: Polymer response follows Newtonian fluid dynamics with variable refractive index dependent on shear rate.
primitives.breakdown_regime: γ̇ > γ_threshold where γ_threshold denotes yield point of gelatinous medium.

layer2.mapping: Shear-induced refractivity derived from Navier-Stokes equations with nonlinear optical coefficients.
layer2.telemetry: Optical path difference and velocity field divergence across polymer matrix.

primitives.name: Heat-Activated Pigment Shift
primitives.verbatim_quote: `03-thermochromic-flux`: *The Thermal Threshold* — Molecular pigment shifts responding to heat gradients, radiating iridescent amber and deep emerald.
primitives.assumptions: Pigment molecules exhibit quantum tunnelling under thermal excitation, altering absorption bands.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T > T_activation where T_activation is activation energy barrier for molecular shift.

layer2.mapping: Spectral reflectance modeled as a Boltzmann-weighted sum over excited electronic states.
layer2.telemetry: Spectral reflectance curves and thermal gradient map intensity.
